chunks: And whatever is in it from Bashshār ibn Yasār, I have narrated it from al-Ḥusayn ibn Aḥmad ibn Idrīs—may Allah be pleased with him—from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Abī al-Ṣahbān, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Bashshār ibn Yasār.
ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Bashshār ibn Yasār in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Bashshār ibn Yasār in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the precise line of transmission for hadith authentication and source tracing.
